sub_graphs.title: EIP-7883: ModExp Gas Cost Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas cost calculation process for ModExp precompile operations

nodes.label: ModExp Call Received
nodes.description: Precompile at 0x05 has received a call with base, modulus, and exponent data

nodes.label: Parse Input Lengths
nodes.description: Extract base_length, modulus_length, and exponent_length from calldata

nodes.label: Input Lengths Parsed
nodes.description: Byte lengths for base, modulus, and exponent are known

nodes.label: Compute Multiplication Complexity
nodes.description: Calculate complexity using max(base_length, modulus_length) with minimum of 16 for small inputs, or 2*words^2 for larger

nodes.label: Multiplication Complexity Computed
nodes.description: Complexity factor based on operand sizes is determined

nodes.label: Compute Iteration Count
nodes.description: Calculate iteration count based on exponent size and bit length with multiplier of 16

nodes.label: Iteration Count Computed
nodes.description: Number of iterations for exponentiation is determined

nodes.label: Compute Final Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate max(500, floor(multiplication_complexity * iteration_count))

nodes.label: Gas Cost Determined
nodes.description: Final gas cost for ModExp operation is calculated

edges.label: Calculate final cost with floor of 500

external_entities.name: EVM Caller
external_entities.description: Smart contract or EOA calling the ModExp precompile

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7883: ModExp Precompile Execution
sub_graphs.description: Models the execution flow of the ModExp precompile after gas calculation

nodes.label: Gas Charged for ModExp
nodes.description: Required gas has been deducted from caller's gas supply

nodes.label: Extract Operands from Calldata
nodes.description: Extract actual base, modulus, and exponent values from calldata

nodes.label: Operands Extracted
nodes.description: Base, modulus, and exponent big integers are ready

nodes.label: Execute Modular Exponentiation
nodes.description: Compute base^exponent mod modulus

nodes.label: ModExp Result Computed
nodes.description: Modular exponentiation result is available

nodes.label: Return Result to Caller
nodes.description: Return result padded to modulus_length bytes

nodes.label: Precompile Call Complete
nodes.description: ModExp execution finished, control returns to caller

nodes.label: Out of Gas
nodes.description: Insufficient gas to execute ModExp operation

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7883: Gas Pricing Formula Components
sub_graphs.description: Models the individual formula components and their constraints in gas pricing

nodes.label: Input Parameters Available
nodes.description: base_length, modulus_length, exponent_length, and exponent value available

nodes.label: Compute Max Length
nodes.description: Calculate max(base_length, modulus_length)

nodes.label: Compute Words
nodes.description: Calculate ceil(max_length / 8)

nodes.label: Apply Minimum 32-Byte Assumption
nodes.description: For small inputs, assume minimum 32 bytes with complexity of 16

nodes.label: Compute Large Input Complexity
nodes.description: For inputs > 32 bytes, compute 2 * words^2

nodes.label: Complexity Factor Ready
nodes.description: Multiplication complexity factor computed

nodes.label: Compute Exponent Bit Length
nodes.description: Calculate bit length of exponent value

nodes.label: Compute Small Exponent Iterations
nodes.description: For exponent <= 32 bytes, use bit_length - 1

nodes.label: Compute Large Exponent Iterations
nodes.description: For exponent > 32 bytes, use (16 * (exponent_length - 32)) + bit_length

nodes.label: Iteration Factor Ready
nodes.description: Iteration count computed based on exponent

nodes.label: Apply Minimum Floor of 500
nodes.description: Return max(500, complexity * iterations)

nodes.label: Final Gas Cost Ready
nodes.description: Gas cost determined with minimum of 500

ambiguities.text: Test cases show increases ranging from 150% to 9,105% depending on input characteristics
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the wide variance is intentional to more accurately reflect actual computational cost. Contracts relying on current gas costs may need adjustments.

ambiguities.text: The specification provides no explicit error handling
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume malformed inputs result in standard precompile failure behavior with all gas consumed and no return data.

implicit_assumptions.description: Existing contracts using ModExp have sufficient gas budget to absorb 150-200% cost increases
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts with tight gas budgets may fail unexpectedly after fork activation, potentially locking funds or breaking protocols

implicit_assumptions.description: The new pricing accurately reflects computational cost, preventing DoS via underpriced operations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If new pricing still underprices certain input combinations, attackers could craft inputs that are cheap but computationally expensive

implicit_assumptions.description: Cryptographic libraries using ModExp are not significantly impacted by increased costs
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: On-chain signature verification, RSA operations, and other cryptographic primitives may become economically unviable
